title: agent-ping Documentation Map
scope: Documentation produced by the create-project-documentation skill run of 2026-09-28. Other repository documents exist and are intentionally not mapped; see the exclusion note in the run summary.
instructions: Check the mapped documents relevant to a change before making it, critical and high first, and update them in the same change.
When a change alters commands, environment variables, ports, endpoints, paths or version claims, re-verify those statements against the manifest, scripts or observed output before publishing them.
Keep current behaviour, planned work and unverified claims clearly separated; never present a plan or an unverified claim as shipped behaviour.
Add or update a record here when documentation is created, removed or renamed, and keep each record's path, group, purpose and update_when accurate.
Do not map dot-prefixed paths or generated evidence; they are tooling or build output, not maintained sources.

name: reference-check
items: implementation and tests for every claim made
package.json scripts, dependencies and version against the documented commands
environment variable names, state paths, ports, endpoints and file names against source
version and release date against the authoritative release source
current, planned and unsupported behaviour clearly distinguished
no credentials, tokens, private URLs or copied secret values
no local markdown link broken, including links from nested documents
every mapped path present, unique, repository-relative and not dot-prefixed
